RID user," it's generally referring to a user account identified by its RID within a domain. This is because RIDs are used as part of the SID to identify users within a domain.

Redis is NoSQL database, which stores everything in RAM as key/value pairs such as various types of data structures, example (strings, hashes, lists, sets, and more)

6379/tcp  open  redis       syn-ack Redis key-value store
#redis-cli -h 10.10.63.208
10.10.64.208 > AUTH (authentication_key)
10.10.64.208 > info (Check the keyspace)
10.10.64.208 > keys *
10.10.64.208 > get "internal flag" (one of the keys)

if value is of type string -> GET <key>
if value is of type hash -> HGETALL <key>
if value is of type lists -> lrange <key> <start> <end>
if value is of type sets -> smembers <key>
if value is of type sorted sets -> ZRANGEBYSCORE <key> <min> <max>

10.10.63.208:6379> lrange "authlist" 0 100
